Thanks Mateo — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Network isolation: Our compliance team is pushing for no public internet egress from inference hosts for production workloads (i.e., traffic must be restricted to FinSecure-controlled network or on-prem). For PoC we can accept VPC peering but production needs stronger guarantees.
- KMS: We prefer customer-managed keys. AWS KMS CMK is acceptable if keys are under our account and you support key policies that prevent export. We also want information on any BYOK/HSM options.
- Audit logs: We need immutable audit logs retained for 7 years; ability to export to our S3 bucket or push to our Splunk instance is a requirement.

Procurement timeline: aiming for decision by 2027-05-30. Please include any compliance evidence (SOC 2 artifacts or a summary) and an estimated onboarding timeline + ballpark cost delta between Dedicated and Private.

Thanks — Alice
Director, Compliance | FinSecure
alice.johnson@finsecure.com | +1 212-555-0199

Alice — great questions, answers below and what we’ll include in the SOW/summary pack.

1) Network isolation: 
- Private VPC (our Private offering) supports VPC peering and private IP-only connectivity; production installations can be configured with NAT/Egress restrictions so there is no internet egress from inference hosts.
- For true air-gapped on-prem deployments we provide an on-prem install package and optional offline artifact transfer process; this is typically part of our Private (on-prem) engagement.

2) KMS/BYOK: 
- We support AWS KMS with CMKs in the customer account and key policies that restrict access.
- We also support partner HSM integrations for BYOK and can accommodate customer-managed HSMs for Private on-prem installs (bring-your-own-HSM workflows).

3) Audit logs / retention: 
- Audit logs (inference request metadata, admin actions, and control-plane events) can be exported in near real-time to an S3 bucket you control or streamed to your SIEM (Splunk). Retention is configurable; we can set a 7-year policy on exports.

Deliverables we’ll send in the next 24-48h:
- SOC 2 summary + evidence stub (redwood-soc2-evidence-stub.pdf)
- Detailed data isolation comparison and recommended architecture (attached earlier)
- Draft onboarding timeline and ballpark cost delta (Dedicated vs Private) — will include 6-8 week onboarding estimate for Private VPC and lower lead time for Dedicated.

Would you like us to include an estimated SOW line-item for on-prem HSM setup?

Regards,
Mateo
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Alice / Tom — Marissa from Solutions Engineering here. A few technical clarifications to complement what Mateo sent: 

- Dedicated (Reserved Capacity): provides a dedicated GPU pool for your workload but the control plane and underlying networking remain managed by Redwood; network isolation is strong at the tenant level but not the same as a customer-controlled VPC. Dedicated is faster to onboard (~2-3 weeks) and has lower setup cost, but it does not meet an air-gapped on-prem requirement.

- Private VPC / On-prem: you get a customer-controlled network boundary. Options: 
  * Private VPC (cloud-hosted): deployment in your project/account with VPC peering and no public egress from inference hosts.
  * On-prem air-gapped: offline install with no external egress — we ship artifacts and provide an offline installation guide.

- KMS/HSM note: for Private-on-cloud we recommend AWS KMS CMKs in your account. For on-prem, we support HSM appliances via our BYOHSM integration (different engagement and additional validation).

- Estimated effort: Private VPC onboarding typically 6-8 weeks (network, PKI, validation), on-prem air-gapped ~8-12 weeks depending on site ops. We’ll include a detailed runbook in the SOW.

I’m attaching a simple network-architecture-diagram showing the Private VPC peering and log export flow. Happy to walk through this in the technical call (45-60 min). Proposed slots: Apr 20 (10-12 PT) or Apr 21 (14-16 PT).

Best,
Marissa Cole
